scope.chain: Original a,z -> G_B -> moment observation oracle -> companion projector DAG -> actual INTT -> corrected Omega coordinate
scope.finite_differences: Ordinary differences of product_i sum_j B_ij s_j at base zero; computed only as an independent small oracle
scope.formal_parameters: All z markers formal for n<=4; original a entries sampled in the stated prime field
scope.direct_initialization_checked: mu_0 via product of row sums; mu_1 via the row-pair Leibniz formula, with O(n^3) scalar arithmetic. This does not initialize all remaining moments.

verification_cost.moment_initialization: Enumerates n^n assignments; exponential verification-only initializer, never a supplied polynomial circuit I(n,N).
verification_cost.finite_difference_oracle: Enumerates 2^n parameter evaluations for each frequency; expanded polynomial arithmetic in formal-z mode.
verification_cost.terminal_oracle: Enumerates n! bijective assignments only for independent testing.
verification_cost.companion_component: The actual tested component has exactly N*(4h^2+2h) ordinary scalar gates once moments are supplied.
verification_cost.inverse_ntt: All N^2 summands are evaluated independently; no collapse to a presumed channel in the tested path.
verification_cost.counter_scope: Counts instrumented polynomial arithmetic and enumerations; field exponentiation, input preparation, and Python overhead are not included. This is not a complete scalar gate count.
